## You Found Michigan’s Basement Experts

### Michigan’s Premier   Authority in Basement   Finishing, Waterproofing,   and Crawl Space Repair

At Basements Plus, we don’t just finish basements – we transform them.  We don’t just repair foundations – we solve basement problems.

As a trusted, family-owned basement finishing company in Southeast Michigan, we’ve spent over 20 years helping homeowners reclaim and protect their lower levels. From foundation repair and crawlspace waterproofing to stunning basement transformations, we deliver expert solutions that keep your home dry, safe, and usable.

Whether you’re dealing with water intrusions, cracks in your foundation, or just tired of wasting valuable space, you’re in the right place. We’re here to fix it – once and for all.

Education First Consultations

No pressure. No confusion. Just answers.

Read More

At Basements Plus, we’ve developed efficient, no-hassle systems to guide you through every step of the process. Our experienced team handles the planning, permitting, and execution with professionalism and care, so you can enjoy the results without the headaches.

Stress-free basement remodeling is more than a promise, it’s how we’ve built our reputation.

A Stress-Free Remodeling Experience

From our first visit to the final walkthrough, we’re committed to making your project smooth and stress-free.

Read More

We start every project with a thorough, professional basement inspection – because understanding the _why_ behind your basement issues is just as important as the fix itself. During your Education First Consultation, we explain exactly what’s going on in your home and why we’re recommending a specific solution.

Whether it’s basement waterproofing, foundation stabilization, or finishing from the studs up, you’ll leave your consultation knowing exactly what’s in your estimate and how we’ll help you love your basement again.
